searchText: Hello everyone 👋 Me and <@703292811969036399> are trying to run some benchmarks on the cost of ERC-4337 after Verkle. I was looking for a way to apply post-verkle gas costs in `go-ethereum` but so far I wasn't able to use it. Is there currently a way to do it? If so, could anyone please help us with some instructions on how to bring up such a node locally? I didn't see any documentation on the topic, but what I have tried is setting `VerkleTime` and/or `OverrideVerkle` parameters in config/genesis file. I tried the `master` branch and a few others, but got crashes every time. Thank you! In addition to what Vitalik helpfully explained here, for those curious on the quantum topic I'd also recommend checking out: 1) Ignacio's explainer on the tradeoffs of using EC-based Verkle (wrt quantum), and other areas elliptic curves currently used (1:09:21): https://www.youtube.com/live/H_M9bjwtMhU?si=L5c0YsIu0LeN7cSg&t=4161 2) Vitalik's recent ethresearch post on how to hard-fork in a quantum emergency: https://ethresear.ch/t/how-to-hard-fork-to-save-most-users-funds-in-a-quantum-emergency/18901 (my own 2c is there are solid reasons to debate verkle vs potential other solutions, and quantum-readiness is a variable but shouldn't be a driving factor at this current point in time) cc <@353136597522448385> who may be able to provide guidance (sidenote: <@703301497194152108> may also be helpful to attend the next Verkle Implementers Call if you are able 🙏 April 8 @ 14:00 UTC and agenda here: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1005)

excerpts.author: alexf5200
excerpts.content:
Hello everyone 👋
Me and <@703292811969036399> are trying to run some benchmarks on the cost of ERC-4337 after Verkle. I was looking for a way to apply post-verkle gas costs in `go-ethereum` but so far I wasn't able to use it.
Is there currently a way to do it? If so, could anyone please help us with some instructions on how to bring up such a node locally?

I didn't see any documentation on the topic, but what I have tried is setting `VerkleTime` and/or `OverrideVerkle` parameters in config/genesis file. I tried the `master` branch and a few others, but got crashes every time.

Thank you!

excerpts.author: rudolf6
excerpts.content:
In addition to what Vitalik helpfully explained here, for those curious on the quantum topic I'd also recommend checking out:  

1) Ignacio's explainer on the tradeoffs of using EC-based Verkle (wrt quantum), and other areas elliptic curves currently used (1:09:21): https://www.youtube.com/live/H_M9bjwtMhU?si=L5c0YsIu0LeN7cSg&t=4161

2) Vitalik's recent ethresearch post on how to hard-fork in a quantum emergency: https://ethresear.ch/t/how-to-hard-fork-to-save-most-users-funds-in-a-quantum-emergency/18901 

(my own 2c is there are solid reasons to debate verkle vs potential other solutions, and quantum-readiness is a variable but shouldn't be a driving factor at this current point in time)
